newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha ends modestly higher on swaps strength.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha ends modestly higher on swaps strength.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices ended modestly higher on continued buying interest in the swaps, which were dragging up a reluctant wet market.
Heavy bidding in the Nov swaps and crude's strength underpinned physical naphtha, but traders said end-user demand was satisfied until the second half of the month.
A cargo bid for pipeline spec material to be delivered by Nov 20 into northwest Europe was still seen in the market today but no traders were heard done.
"The market is probably balanced," said one broker.
